heading: The Visa Expeditor Difference
subheading: Same application, a very different experience depending on how you get there.

us.title: Plain-language guidance
us.description: Every form explained step by step — no government jargon to decode.

diy.title: Dense official forms
diy.description: Navigate government terminology and formatting that varies by country.

us.title: Reviewed by former visa officers
us.description: A second set of expert eyes on your application before it's ever submitted.

diy.title: No second opinion
diy.description: Submit and hope — mistakes are usually caught only after a rejection.

us.title: Upfront, itemized pricing
us.description: See the full cost — government and service fees — before you commit to anything.

diy.title: Fees you discover along the way
diy.description: Notarization, courier, and processing costs often surface one at a time.

us.title: Real-time status tracking
us.description: Know exactly where your application stands, from submission to delivery.

diy.title: Radio silence while you wait
diy.description: Once it's submitted, there's little visibility into where things stand.

us.title: Help in your language
us.description: Get guidance and support in the language you're most comfortable with.

diy.title: Requirements in one language only
diy.description: Instructions are typically published only in the destination country's official language.
